claims.evidence: Witness photos show a dining table set: black metal framed tables with wooden tabletops that have rectangular openings, plus lower metal racks/shelves; no sewing/weaving machine legs are shown.
Witness report contains no price list or comparable pricing; only item visuals are described.
Witness report does not include location details; only the item appearance is described.

risks.risk: Missing/uncounted chairs or seats (photos don’t confirm the full set quantity).
risks.proof: A photo showing the full set laid out with a clear count of all chairs/seat pieces included.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a worst-case partial set (fewer seats than expected) and treat any missing seats as not included.

risks.risk: Tabletop insert material and condition (glass/stone/wood) is not visible—only the rectangular opening is shown.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the insert piece (if present) showing material type and any chips/cracks, plus a photo of it fitted into the opening.
risks.if_unproven: Price as missing or damaged insert (worst case: insert not included or not usable).

risks.risk: Stability/wobble and joint looseness not shown; metal frame sturdiness is only visually inferred.
risks.proof: Short video of the table being pushed/shaken gently from different sides to show wobble, plus a close-up of joints/fasteners.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially unstable/needs tightening (worst case: buyer must repair).

risks.risk: Rust depth and corrosion on black metal frame/lower rack not assessed (surface wear is visible but depth isn’t).
risks.proof: Photo/clip of the most rust-prone corners and underside of the lower rack at close range.
risks.if_unproven: Price as having rust that may require sanding/treatment.

risks.risk: Wood condition beyond visible grain/light wear—possible cracks/splits or peeling varnish not captured.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of tabletop edges and corners (top and underside) showing any cracks, splits, or peeling finish.
risks.if_unproven: Price as having unknown wood defects (worst case: minor repairs needed).

risks.risk: Missing hardware/protective caps (fasteners, leveling feet, or caps) not shown.
risks.proof: Photos of all table leg ends and underside showing feet/caps and fasteners; include a shot of any loose parts.
risks.if_unproven: Price as missing/uncertain protective caps (worst case: buyer must replace).

proof_requests: Show the full set clearly (tables + every chair/seat) with a visible count.
Show the tabletop insert piece (if any): close-up of material (glass/stone/wood) and condition, and a photo of it fitted into the opening.
Send a short video testing table stability (gentle push from all sides) and showing joints/fasteners.
Provide close-ups of the underside and corners of the metal frame/lower rack to assess rust depth.
Provide close-ups of tabletop edges/corners for cracks/splits and finish peeling (top and underside).
Show leg ends/underside for protective caps/feet and confirm all fasteners are present.
response.reason: The witness report clearly identifies the item type as a dining table set with black metal frames and wooden tabletops with rectangular openings, so it can be priced at worst-case condition. However, several key details (insert presence/material, full seat count, stability, rust depth, wood defects) are not fully verifiable from the shown angles, so the price should assume the worst until the requested proof is provided.
